using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine.Blocks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class VarBlockTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<VarBlock>> _mockLogger = new();

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_LogsError_WhenContentLengthLessThan2()
    {
        // Arrange
        string shortContent = "$";
        var loggerFactory = Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(f => f.CreateLogger<VarBlock>() == _mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        _ = new VarBlock(shortContent, loggerFactory);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("The variable name is empty")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_SetsNameEmpty_WhenContentLengthLessThan2()
    {
        // Arrange
        string shortContent = "$";
        var loggerFactory = Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(f => f.CreateLogger<VarBlock>() == _mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        var block = new VarBlock(shortContent, loggerFactory);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(string.Empty, block.Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentEmpty()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new VarBlock(null);

        // Act
        bool isValid = block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("A variable must start with the symbol $ and have a name")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentDoesNotStartWithDollar()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new VarBlock("abc");

        // Act
        bool isValid = block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("A variable must start with the symbol $")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_LogsError_WhenContentLengthLessThan2()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new VarBlock("$");

        // Act
        bool isValid = block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("The variable name is empty")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
